summary: Added the missing west side for the three RP-0914 transfers (HX-1003 +10, HX-1006 +10, HX-1013 +4), then refilled 18 eligible west items to twice their reorder_point from north then east, never taking a source below its reorder_point. Seven items could not be fully covered and are in shortfall.csv; HX-1009's get_item output disagreed with the adjustment ledger and adjust_stock, so I used the ledger-consistent east quantity of 42.
